title: Counting to 20
standard_text: K.2A count forward and backward to at least 20 with and without objects; K.2C count a set of objects up to at least 20 and demonstrate that the last number said tells the number of objects in the set regardless of their arrangement or order
meta_desc: Free kindergarten counting worksheets for Texas TEKS K.2A and K.2C: count objects to 20, how counting works and counting stories with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Touch each one. The last number tells how many.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Touch each thing once and say one number.
  • The last number you say tells how many.
  • Moving the things does not change how many.
  • Count forward: 1, 2, 3 … Count back: 20, 19, 18 …

Examples

Example

Count the apples

1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7

Answer: 7 apples

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting one thing twiceTouch each thing once.
Skipping a thingMove each thing as you count it.
Saying a number after the last oneStop when every thing is counted.

faq.q: Does moving the things change how many?
faq.a: No. The number stays the same.

faq.q: How can I help my child count?
faq.a: Count real things together and touch each one.
